limitations: Approximate C pseudocode, not original Objective-C/Swift source.
Entry candidates come from compact unwind, function-start and Objective-C runtime metadata; unlisted or stripped routines may be absent.
Function ranges use the next candidate as their upper bound; types and prototypes are incomplete.
Every unsuccessful candidate is recorded in an index TSV.
